title: MILPaC: A Novel Benchmark for Evaluating Translation of Legal Text to Indian Languages
reasoning: The paper focuses on benchmarking machine translation systems for legal text. While legal text may contain ethical principles, the evaluation metrics (Preservation of Meaning, Suitability for Legal Use, Fluency) are focused on translation quality, formality, and accuracy for legal drafting, not on evaluating the models' handling of ethical dilemmas, religious content, or moral reasoning itself. It does not benchmark faith or ethics as a specific component.
